text:
alice: deploy-bot just paused the rollout to 50% — p95 latency jumped, looks like a spike :eyes:
deploy-bot: Rollout status: canary 25% -> pause at 50%. Alert: p95 latency 420ms (+180ms vs baseline).
ben: I see the spike on the EU pool, traces point to kvcache misses on gpu-3.
dave: Is this consistently happening across requests or a noise blip?
alice: it's been steady for ~6 minutes, reproducible with the same prompt suite.
carla: we need to decide auto-unwind vs manual rollback — any business/customer impact yet?
dave: no customer-facing errors, just latency degradation. SLA at risk if sustained.
ben: my call: manual rollback to v2.9.1 (previous stable) and pin while we triage. We should avoid auto-revert because the metric noise was close to threshold earlier.
alice: +1 to manual rollback. I'll start the pinned rollback and draft a release note update.
carla: ping legal/CS after we pin — they'll want a brief for any affected enterprise customers.
Ben: (meant to be lowercase) Triggering rollback now: `rwctl rollout set --version v2.9.1 --force-pin --scope eu`
deploy-bot: Rollback command accepted. Initiating staged unwind: 50% -> 25% over 3m, then 0% over 5m.
dave: good. I'll watch the oncall dashboard and keep the bridge open for 30m.
alice: release-notes: adding note: "Emergency pin to v2.9.1 due to p95 latency regression in EU; investigating kvcache behavior on recent kernel changes." Keep it short.
carla: comms: CS template ready, mark customers with heavy traffic and offer prioritized follow-up. I'll send once rollback completes.
ben: after rollback completes we should run the failed prompt set against the candidate binary in staging with debug flags: `INSTRUMENT_KV=1 ./ci/run_prompt_set.sh --suite=regress-2024-09`
adam: (joined) saw alert, backing off any traffic changes on dependent infra — let me know if you need extra capacity routed.
dave: rollback at 25% now, p95 trending down to 210ms.
alice: keep the pin for now until Ben confirms root cause or we have a safe patch. Don't unpin automatically.
ben: agreed. I'll open a follow-up issue with logs and initial hypothesis: kernel flag + KV eviction misalignment.
carla: once Ben posts the issue, I'll update the internal incident doc and notify legal/CS with the blurb.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: target version v2.9.1 pinned for eu region.
dave: closing the bridge in 20m if metrics stay stable, will escalate otherwise.
alice: thanks everyone — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
carla: reminder: add an items checklist for postmortem (timeline, rollback criteria, patch plan, customer comms) so we can refine thresholds.
ben: will do. creating the issue and tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-sre.
carla: ok. closing thread when postmortem link is added.
